subject: Biology

objectives.name: Demonstrate knowledge and understanding of scientific ideas, processes, techniques and procedures
Apply knowledge and understanding of scientific ideas, processes, techniques and procedures
Analyse, interpret and evaluate scientific information, ideas and evidence

components.name: Paper 1
components.format: 76 marks of short and long answer questions; 15 marks of extended response

components.name: Paper 2
components.format: 76 marks of short and long answer questions; 15 marks comprehension

components.name: Paper 3
components.format: 38 marks structured including practical techniques; 15 marks critical analysis of experimental data; 25 marks one essay from a choice of two

notes: Assessment objectives are set by Ofqual and are identical across every board's A-level Biology; only the weightings differ.
At least 15% of the overall assessment covers knowledge, skills and understanding in relation to practical work.
10% of the overall assessment contains mathematical skills at Level 2 or above.
